description: Copies the images a site made with Import a website saved under public/ (a project with IMPORTED.md) into the project you are rebuilding it in, at the same paths, so /assets/... image URLs keep working. Without paths it copies every image the import saved that this project doesn't have yet, up to 30 per call: call it again while the answer says more are left. Images over 5 MB, fonts and other files aren't copied; the answer lists what the owner should upload in the Assets panel. Lottie .json files are text: read_file them on the imported project and write_file them to the same path. The copies are saved at once, like every edit. Skill rebuild-imported-site.

importedProjectId.description: The project Import a website created (it has IMPORTED.md)

paths.description: Only these images, as paths in the imported project such as public/assets/hero.webp. Leave out to copy the rest of them

projectId.description: The project the images go to (the rebuild), not the imported one

name: copy_imported_images
title: Copy imported images
